name: Tight Bounding Box Calculation for Quadric Gaussians
definition: A method to compute a tight 2D axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) for quadratic Gaussian primitives (QGS) by using tangent planes, avoiding the loose approximation of projecting the 3D bounding box vertices.
summary: This method computes a tight 2D axis-aligned bounding box for Quadratic Gaussian Splatting primitives by approximating boundaries with tangent planes, avoiding loose vertex projections.
